question: Who was executed as an accomplice to the murder of AMT Jackson?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Krishnaji Gopal Karve**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Krishnaji Gopal Karve** was executed as an accomplice to the murder of AMT Jackson.
 
• AMT Jackson was a British officer assassinated in 1909.
 
• Krishnaji Gopal Karve was associated with the revolutionary activities aimed at overthrowing British rule in India.
 
• He played a significant role in the revolutionary movement and was ultimately arrested and executed for his involvement in the assassination.
 
• This incident is a notable event in the history of India's struggle for independence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Matangini Hazra** was a freedom fighter who was not involved in this particular incident.
 
• **Khudiram Bose** was another revolutionary who was executed for his role in the Muzaffarpur conspiracy case, not related to AMT Jackson's murder.
 
• **Hemu Kalani** was a freedom fighter from Sindh who was executed by the British during the Quit India Movement, unrelated to this case.
 
• The incident involving AMT Jackson is a part of the larger revolutionary activities against British colonial rule in the early 20th century.
